notes:
Snapshots from calls and sales notes:
- Business: multi-vertical marketplace (home, apparel, electronics). Catalog ~25M SKUs, growing 30% YoY. Heavy seasonality (Black Friday + Holiday window = 8-12x baseline).
- Primary objective: replace brittle keyword-based search + slow business-rules reranker with semantic retrieval + learned reranker to improve conversion on long-tail SKUs.
- Technical targets (requested by VP of Search):
  * Cost target: <= $0.0015 per query (end-to-end retrieval + rerank) at baseline; keep sub-$0.005 at peak bursts via autoscaling/caching.
  * Latency SLO: p95 end-to-end < 250ms (preferred <200ms). Search path split: ANN retrieval ~<100ms, reranker ~<150ms p95.
  * Index scale: 25M 768-d vectors, expected 3-5 updates/sec (product feed), retention of embeddings for 13 months.
- Proposed architecture notes from SE: use quantized vector store with HNSW w/ sharding + asynchronous KV cache for hot prefixes; rerank as a lightweight 3B-class model or distilled re-ranker to reduce per-query cost. Consider per-customer model routing to cheaper variant during non-peak.
- Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML), SOC2 evidence, audit logs forwarded to SIEM, KMS integration for at-rest keys, and EU data residency for EU customers.
- Commercial: prefer Dedicated or Private for isolation and predictable tail-latency during spikes. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization to meet cost targets.
- Quote from VP of Search on 2026-02-12 call: "We need a solution that keeps our peak spend from blowing up during holidays — hit conversion uplift but keep cost predictable."
- POC success metrics (agreed): recall@100 >= current, conversion delta >= +1.5% on holdout, end-to-end cost per query measured and modeled for committed vs burst pricing.
- Risks: current incumbent (Elastic + custom reranker) has existing integrations; migration risk for signals (pricing, inventory) into dense vectors.
- Next actions: SE to provision test index + sample ingestion script; run baseline latency/cost tests; security to sign off on data flow diagram (DFD) and KMS integration.
- Short notes/cheat-sheet: "POC must show p95 <=250ms, cost <=0.0015 baseline, graceful degradation at 10x traffic".
- Internal references: drive pricing deck + security FAQ shared (links above). Jira tickets opened for POC infra (INF-4129) and security clarifications (SEC-704).
